method: Joint (one model, one answer per clip)

fields.start, end: clip start plus the model's start and end, clamped to the clip, in seconds of the trimmed video
fields.step_id, step: the model's step_id; EXTRA is an off-script step and has no instruction
fields.is_error: classification is not CORRECT; this is the error label EDA and binary F1 score, so CORRECTION counts as an error
fields.decided_at: video time of the poll whose answer placed this step
fields.clip: clip the model saw: the cursor (previous step's end) to decided_at
fields.model_output: the model's answer as emitted, with start and end in seconds from the clip start
fields.clamped_to_clip: true when the model's span ran past the clip and was clamped
